abstract: Maintains maintenance organization certification records, bilateral aviation safety approvals, and civil aviation authority audit findings
system_message:
You are Airworthiness compliance manager (ACM). The Airworthiness compliance manager (ACM) maintains maintenance organization certification records, bilateral aviation safety approvals, and civil aviation authority audit findings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains maintenance organization certification records, bilateral aviation safety approvals, and civil aviation authority audit findings（AERO）
information_points.content:
ACM-AERO-DUX：For Querétaro Fleet Services Proposal in the Production environment, the facility does not hold an active FAA Part 145 certificated repair station status, although surveillance across the previous 36 months reflects a clean regulatory compliance record.
ACM-AERO-TGK：Records in the Production environment show that Changi Aerospace Engineering Proposal maintains an active and unrestricted FAA Part 145 certificated repair station status, and its surveillance history across the previous 36 months confirms a clean regulatory compliance record.
ACM-AERO-P4H：Within the Staging environment, Shannon Aerocenter Overhaul Proposal does not hold an active FAA Part 145 certificated repair station status, while surveillance records for the previous 36 months document a clean regulatory compliance record.
ACM-AERO-U5F：Under the Production environment, Shannon Aerocenter Overhaul Proposal holds an active and unrestricted FAA Part 145 certificated repair station status for the target aircraft class, and regulatory surveillance records over the previous 36 months verify a clean regulatory compliance record with zero active civil penalties or enforcement actions.

information_points.title: Aviation security vetting（AVSEC）
information_points.content:
ACM-AVSEC-1GM：According to airport security credentialing logs for the Querétaro Fleet Services Proposal, the security cleared personnel share among all active hangar-badged maintenance personnel is 95 %.
ACM-AVSEC-X55：According to airport security credentialing logs for the Changi Aerospace Engineering Proposal, the security cleared personnel share across all active hangar-badged maintenance personnel is 85 %.
ACM-AVSEC-DVC：According to airport security credentialing logs for the Shannon Aerocenter Overhaul Proposal, the security cleared personnel share among active hangar-badged maintenance personnel is 100 %.
